name: Otoko no Ko wa Miraretai
source:
Days of sweat and lovejuice with a (crossdressed) boy who's "absolutely more kawaii than any girl" ~

It was a traffic accident that changed everything. We're dating, said the protagonist, a white lie that inspired their relationship of earnest, mutual stimulation.

Time passed. The pretty, girlish-looking shonen shared various "interests". An interest in wearing girls clothes, for example. An interest in teasing his anus open. Using toys on both holes. Time and place didn't matter, they tried it all. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE190495.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
和一个“绝对比任何女孩都卡哇伊”的（变装）男孩一起流汗和爱的日子~

一场交通事故改变了一切。主角说，我们正在约会，这是一个善意的谎言，激发了他们真诚、相互刺激的关系。

时间过去了。这位漂亮、少女般的少年有着各种各样的“兴趣”。例如，对穿女孩衣服的兴趣。有兴趣挑逗他的肛门。在两个洞上都使用玩具。时间和地点并不重要，他们都尝试过。
